'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Steve Harpster DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet title ARTIS HD DUELING / HD Dueling (AOBS crossed). Header Hamster in inventory.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Harpster]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
